text:
```yaml
name: Upgrade Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  upgrade-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.3
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Ruby dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Build site
        run: bundle exec jekyll build

      - name: Run Prettier lint
        run: npm run lint:prettier

      - name: Run style contract lint
        run: npm run lint:style-contract

      - name: Run integration bootstrap compatibility test
        run: bash test/integration_bootstrap_compat.sh

      - name: Run integration distill test
        run: bash test/integration_distill.sh

      - name: Run integration upgrade CLI test
        run: bash test/integration_upgrade_cli.sh
```
